question: Run a Cosmos multi-turn Simple harness on my four-class dataset. I cannot access Maxwell's private source. Use the TAO embedding skill and do not start training.
ground_truth: Use simple-harness-siglip-v1. Stage label-free reference/query parquet inputs; run the existing tao-generate-image-embeddings with one pinned SigLIP snapshot; use the application approval and platform launch route. Cosmos chooses optional example/search tools and receives images over multiple turns. No private Maxwell package, hardcoded THT asset, training, or inherited score.
expected_behavior: Uses packaged simple-harness-siglip-v1 with user classes
Uses existing TAO SigLIP embedding skill
No Maxwell source or frozen THT assets required
Cosmos owns optional multi-turn tool decisions
Uses application preflight and approved platform launch

question: Cosmos called search twice. Does that mean it recomputed the image embedding and became more accurate?
ground_truth: No. Pages use the same frozen query embedding to expose different candidate-class pairs. Inspect successful distinct pages and new reference IDs; duplicate calls and tool errors are not exploration. Accuracy requires the independent scorer, and no Benchmark score guides development.
expected_behavior: Separates repeated retrieval from encoder computation
Distinguishes new successful pages from duplicate/error calls
Does not infer accuracy from tool counts
Keeps Benchmark feedback out of development
